name: Danielle Sellick
title: Principal Psychologist (Clinical), MAPS, FCCLP
description: Danielle helps adults experiencing anxiety and panic, depression, trauma, relationship, workplace and parenting concerns, grief and loss, and more. She also provides clinical supervision and consultation as an EMDRAA Accredited Consultant. Danielle uses EMDR therapy, Schema therapy, Ego State Therapy, CBT and other evidence-based therapies. Former board Director of EMDRAA.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, schema therapy, ego state therapy, supervision

name: Miriam Taouk
title: Senior Psychologist
description: Miriam combines evidence-based treatments, including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, EMDR Therapy, Ego State Therapy, and Schema Therapy, with a holistic approach. Miriam has also completed training in Deep Brain Reorienting (DBR), and additional training in working with Dissociative Identity Disorder and Sensorimotor Psychotherapy. She treats anxiety, depression, drug and alcohol abuse, grief and loss, trauma, and relationships.
specialties: EMDR, Dissociative Identity Disorder, DBR, sensorimotor psychotherapy, ego state therapy, schema therapy, trauma, eating disorders

name: Renae Vanderheyden
title: Psychologist
description: Renae combines CBT, Schema Therapy, Ego State Therapy and ACT, and has completed EMDR Level 2 training. She works collaboratively with clients across a broad range of presenting issues including complex PTSD, trauma, attachment, anxiety, depression, addiction, ADHD, grief & loss, relationships and couple's therapy. She provides a supportive environment for the client to explore and understand past, complex traumas.
specialties: complex PTSD, trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, ego state therapy, couples

name: Vicki Ashton
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Vicki is a clinical psychologist with 15 years experience working with children, parents, young people and adults experiencing emotional and relational problems. She has completed EMDR Level 1 and Level 2 training.
specialties: EMDR, children, parents, young people, relational problems

name: Eman Shehata
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Eman is a Clinical Psychologist and Behaviour Support Practitioner who has completed level 2 training in EMDR. She has a keen interest in supporting people struggling to manage behaviour concerns, trauma/PTSD, addictions, anger, shame, anxiety, depression, interpersonal relationship issues and parenting. Works with children, adolescents and adults.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, PTSD, behaviour support, addictions

name: Dr Christopher Holt
title: Psychologist
description: Chris's work utilises a range of evidence-based psychological treatments, including cognitive behavioural therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, brief solution focused therapy, EMDR Therapy and positive psychology. Senior lecturer at ACAP University College; research on CBT for perinatal depression and anxiety.

name: Dr Rebecca Barnett
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Rebecca works with adults experiencing mood disorders, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorders, obsessive compulsive disorder, trauma, abuse, grief and loss, among other issues, using CBT, ACT, Internal Family Systems (IFS) therapy, and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) therapy.
specialties: trauma, EMDR, IFS (parts), bipolar, OCD, abuse
